name: prowler
description: Connect Claude to Prowler Cloud through the Prowler MCP server. Reads providers, scans, findings, compliance results and resources for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365, GitHub and the other providers listed at https://registry.prowler.com, and returns remediation guidance for failed checks. Writes are limited to Prowler Cloud itself: triggering scans, finding triage, mute rules and the mutelist, providers and integrations. Your cloud resources are not changed by the connector.

api_key.title: Prowler API key
api_key.description: API key token used to authenticate with Prowler (Prowler Cloud, Prowler Private Cloud, or Prowler Local Server) via the Prowler MCP server. Create one at https://cloud.prowler.com.
